The cheapest MacBook Air currently sold by Apple in the US is the 13-inch M5 model at **$1,299**. I couldn't load Apple's own store page, so these figures come from third-party reporting.

- **13-inch M5 Air:** MacRumors reports Apple raised the base price by $200 in June 2026, citing higher memory costs, which put the 13-inch model at $1,299. The 13-inch model now starts at $1,299 and the 15-inch model starts at $1,499.)
- **15-inch M5 Air:** Starts at $1,499 (MacPrices.net also lists Apple's MSRP for the base 15-inch as $1,499).
- **Cheaper Mac, not an Air:** Apple's $699 MacBook Neo is the lowest-priced MacBook overall, per the $699 MacBook Neo reporting.
- **Older model:** Apple no longer sells the M1 MacBook Air new, according to AppleInsider. Older prices like $999 or $1,099 are outdated.

Discounted M4 Air listings at retailers such as Amazon were around $799 in an August 2025 AppleInsider article, but that is stale and not Apple's price.

The cheapest MacBook Pro in Apple's current US lineup is the 14-inch M6 model at **$1,999**. It was announced October 27, 2026 as a mini-LED, non-touch model, and it's the entry-level option in the new lineup. The standard spec includes an M6 chip (12-core CPU, 12-core GPU), 16GB of unified memory, and a 1TB SSD.

The newer touchscreen models cost more. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5 Pro starts at $2,899, while the 16-inch M5 Pro model starts at $3,399. Those touchscreen models go on sale November 6, with preorders starting October 30.

The M5 Pro and M5 Max mini-LED models from earlier in 2026 are still on sale. The 14-inch M5 Pro starts at $2,499, and the 16-inch M5 Pro is priced starting at $2,999.

The most recent deal roundup I found is from September and is about 58 days old, so treat its discounts with caution. It reported a base 14-inch model hit $1,499, but that was a retailer sale price, not Apple's list price.

**Cheapest MacBook Air (US): $1,299** for the 13-inch M5 model, per third-party reporting. Apple raised the MacBook Air base price by $200 in June 2026, citing memory costs. I couldn't load Apple's store page, so verify on [apple.com](https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/) before buying.

**Cheapest MacBook Pro (US): $1,999** for the 14-inch M6 model, announced October 27, 2026. It's a non-touch mini-LED model. The [9to5Mac report](https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/29/you-can-now-spend-between-1999-and-14549-on-a-macbook-pro/) gives $1,999 as the low end of the lineup.

**Comparison:** The MacBook Pro's base price is $700 higher than the MacBook Air's.

Other notes:
- Apple's $699 MacBook Neo is cheaper than both, but it isn't an Air or a Pro.

- The M5 Pro MacBook Pros still on sale start at $2,499 (14-inch) and $2,999 (16-inch). Touchscreen models start at $2,899 and go on sale November 6, per [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/28/new-macbook-pro-maxed-out-cost/).
- Retailer discounts can go lower. Check current deals before comparing.
